d01_concurrent_direct_call.title: the compiler flags the call of a direct module from a concurrent aspect (D-129)

d02_concurrent_managed_call.title: a concurrent aspect calls a managed module (D-129)

d02_test1.title: variation 1 of d02: the concurrent aspect with another input (D-133)

d03_concurrent_bare_call.title: a concurrent aspect can not call an unsafe member, also by a bare name from m(*) (D-129)

d04_parallel_group.title: two parallel groups run one after the other; the output of a group is in the order of start (D-140)

d05_parallel_outputs.title: each started aspect writes its own element of an array; the results are ready after done (D-140)

d05_test1.title: variation 1 of d05: start inside if, inputs by value, a declaration local to the group (D-140)

d06_start_exclusive.title: start of an aspect without a kind word is a compile error: it is exclusive (D-130, D-140)

d07_start_outside_group.title: start outside the do region of a parallel group is a compile error (D-140)

d08_same_output.title: two starts of a group can not receive the same output variable (D-140, $err_output)

d08_test1.title: variation 1 of d08: an output with a computed index is checked at start: $err_output 43 (D-140)

d09_parallel_error.title: failed tasks do not stop the others; done raises ParallelError with the errors in the order of start (D-140)

d09_test1.title: variation 1 of d09: nobody recovers the ParallelError: exit 4, one line per failed task (D-140)

d09_test2.title: variation 2 of d09: retry in recover runs the whole group again (D-066, D-140)

d10_on_error_cancel.title: on error cancel stops the other tasks after the first failure; they are counted, not listed (D-140)

d11_within_timeout.title: within sets a deadline: a task still running gets a TimeoutError (D-140, D-144)

d12_channel_pipeline.title: a pipeline: one producer, four workers and a collector connected by two channels (D-141)

d13_channel_closed.title: send into a closed channel raises ChannelError, code 46 (D-141)

d14_deadlock.title: a consumer that waits on a channel nobody sends to is a deadlock; the error names it (D-141)

d15_atomic_counter.title: eight tasks add to an Atomic(:Integer) of a managed module: the total is exact (D-132, D-140)

d16_split_batch.title: split(k) and batch(n) cut a list; the parts are summed in parallel and combined by index (D-142)

d17_job_spawn.title: spawn starts async procedures in a job, await waits for an async function; done waits for every task (D-143)

d18_spawn_function.title: spawn of an async function is a compile error: its result would be lost (D-143)

d19_async_plain_call.title: an async procedure called without spawn or await is a compile error (D-104 b)

d20_trait.title: a class adopts a trait: it writes the required method and gets the provided one (D-145)

d21_trait_missing_method.title: a class that does not write a required method of its trait is a compile error (D-145)

d22_abstract_class.title: an abstract class is built only by the constructor of a subclass that writes its required method (D-145)

d23_abstract_new.title: an abstract class can not be created outside the constructor of a subclass (D-145)

d24_generic_class.title: a generic class is made with its type argument written; a constraint asks for a trait (D-145)

d25_nested_group.title: an aspect started by the driver opens a group of two leaf aspects; outputs keep the order of start (D-081, D-140)

d26_nested_too_many.title: an aspect group holds at most two start statements (D-081, D-140)

d27_start_order.title: the output of a group is written in the order of start, whatever task ends first (D-140, D-144)

d28_channel_receive.title: receive(@x) takes one value; a for loop takes the rest until the channel is closed (D-141)

d28_test1.title: variation 1 of d28: receive from a closed, empty channel raises ChannelError 46 (D-141)

d28_test2.title: variation 2 of d28: a close beyond the number of senders is an error (D-141)

d29_auto_close.title: a failing producer does not close its channel: the machine closes it, so the consumer ends (D-141)

d30_channel_timeout.title: a wait on a channel longer than $timeout raises TimeoutError in that task (D-081, D-141)

d31_leaf_group.title: an aspect started by an aspect is a leaf: a parallel group in it is a compile error (D-081, D-140)

d32_parallel_in_procedure.title: a parallel group in a procedure is a compile error: only in the main of a driver or of an aspect (D-140)

d33_job_spawn_error.title: a failing spawned task does not stop the others; the done of the job raises ParallelError (D-143)

d34_trait_conflict.title: two traits that provide the same method force the class to write it (D-145)

d35_library_traits.title: a Printable object prints its describe; Comparable gives compare to numbers and texts (D-145)
